verdict_reason: Works correctly but adds a fourth copy of the reference-data 503 mapping and its name hides the stub/real switch.

todos.issue: The 'reference data failed, so throw Boom.serverUnavailable("Reference data unavailable", { dataset, cause })' rule now has four homes: call-reference-data.js:13, services/ports/index.js:24 and services/countries/index.js:49 and :144. This PR adds the fourth copy, inside the live-animals set, while the shared reference-data module (services/reference-data/request.js, also touched by this PR) holds none of it.
todos.fix: Must: one function owns how a reference-data failure becomes a 503 Boom tagged with its dataset; commodities, ports and countries all call it. One way: export referenceDataUnavailable(dataset, err) (or a stub-or-real wrapper taking the dataset) from services/reference-data/request.js and use it in all four places, deleting the local copies.

todos.issue: callReferenceData({ stubCall, realCall }) mispredicts: the name says it calls reference data, but in stub mode it never does (line 7-8 returns stubCall()), and in real mode it also turns any failure into a 503 Boom tagged dataset 'commodities'. Neither the stub/real switch nor the 503 mapping is in the name.
todos.fix: Must: the name says the function chooses the stub or reference data by run mode and reports a reference-data failure as commodities unavailable. One way: rename to e.g. fromStubOrReferenceData / commodityLookup, or fold the rename into the shared owner from the duplication item with the dataset as an argument.

todos.issue: const DATASET = 'commodities' sits at module scope but is used by one function (line 14). House rule: a literal used by one function lives in that function.
todos.fix: Must: the dataset literal lives inside the one function that uses it, or becomes an argument if the helper is shared. One way: inline dataset: 'commodities' in the Boom data.
